device.description: 12-bit 500 kSPS SAR ADC with internal 2.5 V reference and synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7818.pdf (SBAS078) p.2 specifications (conversion time, VIH, straight binary, VCC 4.75-5.25 V), p.3 pin configuration and assignments, p.8 digital interface, Figure 2 and Table I timing, p.9 Figure 3 basic conversion timing, p.10 Figure 4 power-down and Figure 5 LSB-first timing, p.11 short-cycle and data format

pages: p.2 (conversion time 1.625 us, VIH 3.0 V to VCC+0.3 V, straight binary, VCC 4.75-5.25 V), p.3 (pins: Mini-DIP-8 and MSOP-8 share one pinout), p.8 (Table I: tCKDS 50 ns max, tCKDD/tCVDD 100 ns max, tCKDE 50 ns max), p.9 (Figure 3), p.10 (Figures 4-5), p.11 (short-cycle, data format)
notModeled: analog input and internal 2.5 V reference (VREF is the reference output, overdrivable by an external 2.0-2.55 V reference)

CONV is a convert-start input, not a chip select: the model treats it as an active-low frame (the SPI-interfacing use, CONV held low through the transfer). In the DSP use of Figure 3 CONV pulses low and returns high while D11..D0 are still clocked out; the model then floats DATA at CONV rise

conversion is clocked by CLK (DATA enabled after the first CLK falling edge, D11..D0 on the following falling edges, valid on the rising edges; DATA Hi-Z after the 13th falling edge); not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once
LSB-first read-out (Figure 5) and short-cycling (CONV high then low during the conversion)
power-down when CONV is still low at the 13th clock, exited on CONV rising (no bus effect)
CONV-to-CLK setup/hold and clock period limits (125 ns - 5 us)
variants: ADS7818EB is the higher-grade ADS7818 (same spec). ADS7834 is the near-identical sibling with its own datasheet.
